idea-plugin.name: Ghi
idea-plugin.description: Ghi (Go, Hierarchy, Interfaces) support for GoLand. Recognizes .ghi files, highlights syntax, supports comments and brace matching, and builds or runs projects in the IDE console with clickable compiler diagnostics. Configure the compiler and project directory under Languages & Frameworks > Ghi. Requires the Ghi compiler. Supports both Class(args) and new Class(args) construction, including qualified and generic classes. Includes Ghi declaration navigation, completion, parameter information, symbol rename and saved-file compiler diagnostics. Adds concrete generic parameter hints, coordinated override/structural-interface rename, and native Go SDK or Mojave-pinned cache completion/navigation. Ambiguous structural rename signatures raise conflicts. Selected Ghi type imports and file-local aliases support completion, navigation, hints and safe rename. Completion can insert imports; explicit intentions import unresolved types or shorten qualified type references with collision-safe aliases. Debug Project builds with source metadata and debugs .ghi files with GoLand's bundled Delve, including line breakpoints, stepping, call stacks, variables and caught exceptions.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Preview 12: line breakpoints can be added and removed while a Ghi program runs under Delve. The debugger briefly pauses the target, updates the breakpoint and resumes execution. Requires a Ghi compiler with `build --debug` support.
